Agent body: inventory, radial menus, SUI pop-ups, mission-list request, ground height

Based on ChatGPT's staged patch (tools/agent/staged-capabilities), reviewed and fixed:
- New commands: inventory, radial_menu/select_radial, sui_pages/sui_respond, mission_list.
- Localized NPC speech: decode the StringIdChatParameter correctly (the staged
  version skipped too few bytes), so greeters report "@file:key" instead of blank.
- choose is refused when no conversation is open (stale-choice bug).
- Ground height: while walking, take z from the nearest outdoor creature; move
  accepts an explicit z. The old fixed height broke the server's line-of-sight
  check, which silently blocked Han, Chewbacca and the greeters.
- look reports z; status reports our container (mount/cell).
- Conversation state is guarded by the world mutex; SUI pages are forgotten
  before replying because the server may reuse the page ID.

Tested on the test galaxy only (ports 46xxx). Not promoted to the live agent.

Agent body: HAM/posture/combat state, combat log, fight reflex, navmesh path walking

- Decode CREO baselines 3/6 and their deltas: posture, states, HAM, level, group,
  target. status reports our own state; look adds posture and health %; inspect
  shows any creature. Events: posture (ours, and anyone incapacitated or dead),
  combat_started/ended, group_joined/left.
- CombatSpam -> "combat" events (attacker, defender, amount, @cbt_spam key).
- Radial menu items carry option names (table generated from RadialOptions.h).
- fight: approach and keep attacking until one side is incapacitated or dead.
- move refuses while incapacitated/dead and stops when the server keeps
  resetting our position (it used to spin until its timeout).
- Ground height: blend nearby creatures within 64 m (Mos Eisley ~5, the
  plateau north-east ~180).
- path / height / move use the server's /agentpath helper when present:
  navmesh routes with ground heights, cell-local points walked with
  DataTransformWithParent, re-planning partial paths. Falls back to a straight
  line outdoors when the helper is missing.

Tested on the test galaxy (dev server): kill, incapacitation, death, clone
SUI; path from the Han platform down to the greeters. Indoor walking untested.

Sandbox: /agentpath helper for the agent client (bot accounts only)

The headless agent client has no terrain or navmeshes. /agentpath asks the
server, which plans with the PathFinderManager the NPCs use:
  /agentpath path <x> <y> [<z> <cellId>]   world or cell-local route
  /agentpath height <x> <y>                 ground height
The answer is a "[agentpath] {json}" system message to the caller only.
Only accounts listed in Core3.AgentAccounts (config-local.lua) may use it;
everyone else gets "insufficient permission". Not deployed.

Sandbox /agentpath: head part of the way when leaving a building for a far target

findPath from a cell to a world point far away can fail on the outdoor leg.
Try points 32/64/128 m along the way instead and mark the answer "partial";
the client re-plans from outside. Verified on the test galaxy: cloning-facility
basement to the Mos Eisley greeters (330 m) in 3 legs.

Sandbox world boss rotation and big game hunter (dev, not deployed)

Three named, tougher versions of existing creatures roam their home planets (14-boss roster, 29 wilderness reference points adapted from SWG Flurry's AGPL world_boss_spt.lua). Unkilled bosses slip away after 6 h and are replaced elsewhere; slain bosses pay 25,000 bank credits to every player on the damage list and refill after 90 min. Galaxy-wide announcements on sighting, kill and escape. Rhea Tannor at the Mos Eisley starport reports current bosses and adds datapad waypoints.
